text: Write or Call Your Elected Officials Today!
Your representatives in Congress need to know that
there is significant opposition to higher cigarette taxes.
Following is address and telephone information you can use
to write or call your U.s. representative and senators.

If you do not know who your representative and senators
are, you can find out by looking in the federal government
section of your telephone book.
If you choose to write to your elected officials,
please keep your letters brief, and politely but firmly
state why you are opposed to higher cigarette taxes. Be
sure to write clearly, and make sure you sign your name and
include your address. You may want to ask for a response to
your letter.
That way you will know exactly how your
representative feels about this important issue.
If you decide to telephone your elected officials,
please be aware that in all likelihood you will be unable to
talk with your legislators directly. Instead, just tell the
staff member who answers the phone that you would like to
leave a brief message for the representative or senator. Be
sure to leave your name and address, and you might want to
ask your legislator to send you a letter explaining his or
her position. Please keep in mind that congressional
